---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m8p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Slots, NULL

VARIABLES
    coarse,   \* holder of the single coarse (lobby-wide) lock, or NULL
    fine,     \* fine[s]: player holding the fine lock on slot s, or NULL
    owner,    \* owner[s]: player the slot has been allocated to, or NULL
    phase,    \* phase[p]: "idle" | "hold" (holds coarse lock)
    alive     \* players that have not silently crashed

vars == <<coarse, fine, owner, phase, alive>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Players \cup {NULL}
    /\ fine \in [Slots -> Players \cup {NULL}]
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Players \cup {NULL}]
    /\ phase \in [Players -> {"idle", "hold"}]
    /\ alive \subseteq Players

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NULL
    /\ fine = [s \in Slots |-> NULL]
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NULL]
    /\ phase = [p \in Players |-> "idle"]
    /\ alive = Players

\* Acquire the coarse lock before touching any slot (coarse then fine).
AcquireCoarse(p) ==
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ phase[p] = "idle"
    /\ coarse = NULL
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![p] = "hold"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, owner, alive>>

\* Under the coarse lock, take the fine lock on a still-free slot.
AcquireFine(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ phase[p] = "hold"
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[s] = NULL
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, owner, phase, alive>>

\* Allocate a slot only while holding its fine lock and while unowned.
Allocate(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[s] = p
    /\ owner[s] = NULL
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, phase, alive>>

\* Fine locks may only be dropped on slots that were never allocated.
ReleaseFine(p, s) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[s] = p
    /\ owner[s] = NULL
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, owner, phase, alive>>

ReleaseCoarse(p) ==
    /\ phase[p] = "hold"
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ coarse' = NULL
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, owner, alive>>

\* A player can vanish without releasing any lock it still holds.
Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, owner, phase>>

\* Once every player has silently crashed the lobby is quiescent.
Done ==
    /\ alive = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players: AcquireCoarse(p) \/ ReleaseCoarse(p) \/ Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots:
           AcquireFine(p, s) \/ Allocate(p, s) \/ ReleaseFine(p, s)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: an allocated slot is still pinned by its allocator's
\* fine lock, so no second player can ever take that slot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A s \in Slots: owner[s] # NULL => fine[s] = owner[s]

=============================================================================
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker assigns seat slots to players using
hierarchical locking: a player must first take the single lobby-wide coarse
lock, then take a fine lock on an individual slot before it may allocate that
slot to itself. A player holding the coarse lock may acquire the fine lock on
any still-free slot, allocate a slot it has fine-locked and that is not yet
owned, release the fine lock on a slot it never allocated, and finally release
the coarse lock to let another player in. Any player may crash silently at any
moment, disappearing without releasing the coarse or fine locks it still holds,
so stale locks can linger; once every player has crashed the lobby goes
quiescent and simply idles. SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot has been allocated
to a player, that same player still holds the fine lock on the slot, so the
slot can never be allocated a second time to anyone else.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p6t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, Proposals, Quorum, Authorized, NULL

VARIABLES
    raised,     \* proposals that have been put to a vote
    tally,      \* tally[pr]: members whose (possibly reordered) vote has arrived
    committed,  \* proposals a quorum has ratified
    rejected,   \* proposals discarded for carrying a stale/foreign vote
    proposer    \* proposer[pr]: the member who raised pr, or NULL

vars == <<raised, tally, committed, rejected, proposer>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ raised \subseteq Proposals
    /\ tally \in [Proposals -> SUBSET Members]
    /\ committed \subseteq Proposals
    /\ rejected \subseteq Proposals
    /\ proposer \in [Proposals -> Members \cup {NULL}]

Init ==
    /\ raised = {}
    /\ tally = [pr \in Proposals |-> {}]
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ rejected = {}
    /\ proposer = [pr \in Proposals |-> NULL]

Resolved(pr) == pr \in committed \/ pr \in rejected

\* A member raises a fresh matchmaking proposal.
Raise(pr, m) ==
    /\ pr \notin raised
    /\ raised' = raised \cup {pr}
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![pr] = m]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, committed, rejected>>

\* Votes arrive in any order; a stray vote from a foreign member is still logged.
Vote(pr, m) ==
    /\ pr \in raised
    /\ ~Resolved(pr)
    /\ m \notin tally[pr]
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![pr] = tally[pr] \cup {m}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<raised, committed, rejected, proposer>>

\* Ratify only when the whole tally is authorized and a quorum is present.
Commit(pr) ==
    /\ pr \in raised
    /\ ~Resolved(pr)
    /\ proposer[pr] \in Authorized
    /\ tally[pr] \subseteq Authorized
    /\ Cardinality(tally[pr]) >= Quorum
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {pr}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<raised, tally, rejected, proposer>>

\* Any proposal that has caught an unauthorized vote is thrown out.
Reject(pr) ==
    /\ pr \in raised
    /\ ~Resolved(pr)
    /\ \E m \in tally[pr] : m \notin Authorized
    /\ rejected' = rejected \cup {pr}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<raised, tally, committed, proposer>>

Done ==
    /\ \A pr \in Proposals : pr \in raised /\ Resolved(pr)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E pr \in Proposals, m \in Members : Raise(pr, m) \/ Vote(pr, m)
    \/ \E pr \in Proposals : Commit(pr) \/ Reject(pr)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stale/unauthorized participant ever contributes to a ratified match:
\* every vote behind a committed proposal came from an authorized member.
NoStaleVote ==
    \A pr \in committed : tally[pr] \subseteq Authorized

=========================================================================
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker ratifies each match proposal by quorum
voting among its members. A member may raise a fresh proposal; votes for a
proposal then arrive in any order because messages can be reordered, and a
stray vote from a foreign or stale member is still logged into the tally. A
proposal is committed only when its proposer is authorized, every vote in its
tally comes from an authorized member, and at least a quorum of votes has
arrived; a proposal whose tally has caught even one unauthorized vote is
instead rejected and discarded. Once every proposal has been raised and either
committed or rejected the round is done and idles. SAFETY PROPERTY: every vote
behind a committed match proposal was cast by an authorized member, so no
stale or unauthorized participant ever contributes to a ratified match.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m1p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, NULL

Drones == 1 .. N
Succ(d) == (d % N) + 1

VARIABLES
    holder,    \* drone currently holding the single ring token
    inCS,      \* drones currently accessing the exclusive comms channel
    override,  \* drone the admin has force-granted access to, or NULL
    want       \* drones that have requested the channel

vars == <<holder, inCS, override, want>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Drones
    /\ inCS \subseteq Drones
    /\ override \in Drones \cup {NULL}
    /\ want \subseteq Drones

Init ==
    /\ holder = 1
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ want = {}

\* The one drone entitled to enter right now: the admin's pick, else the token.
Entitled == IF override = NULL THEN holder ELSE override

Request(d) ==
    /\ d \notin want
    /\ want' = want \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS, override>>

\* The token circulates around the ring, but only while no one is inside.
PassToken ==
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, override, want>>

Enter(d) ==
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ d = Entitled
    /\ d \in want
    /\ inCS' = {d}
    /\ want' = want \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, override>>

Exit(d) ==
    /\ d \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, override, want>>

\* Admin reserves the channel; allowed only when it stands empty.
AdminGrant(d) ==
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ override' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS, want>>

AdminRelease ==
    /\ override # NULL
    /\ override \notin inCS
    /\ override' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS, want>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Request(d) \/ Enter(d) \/ Exit(d) \/ AdminGrant(d)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion of the comms channel: anyone inside is exactly the drone
\* currently entitled (token holder, or the admin's grantee), so two drones can
\* never occupy the channel at once.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A d \in inCS : d = Entitled

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares one exclusive comms channel using a
token ring: a single token circulates from each drone to its ring successor,
and only while the channel is empty. A drone may request the channel; the drone
currently entitled to it is the token holder, unless a privileged admin has
issued an override granting the channel to a specific drone. Only the entitled
drone may enter, and only when the channel is empty; a drone inside may exit at
any time. The admin may grant an override only while the channel is empty and
release it only when its grantee is not inside. SAFETY PROPERTY: every drone
occupying the comms channel is exactly the currently entitled drone, so two
drones can never hold the exclusive channel at the same time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m5p2t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS K, Signals, Quorum, Total, NULL

Blocks == 1 .. K

VARIABLES
    occ,       \* occ[b]: number of trains occupying block b
    ballot,    \* the pending move [from |-> b, to |-> b'], or NULL
    votes,     \* signals whose (reordered) approval of the ballot has arrived
    proposer   \* signal that raised the pending ballot, or NULL

vars == <<occ, ballot, votes, proposer>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occ \in [Blocks -> 0 .. Total]
    /\ ballot \in [from : Blocks, to : Blocks] \cup {NULL}
    /\ votes \subseteq Signals
    /\ proposer \in Signals \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> IF b = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ proposer = NULL

RECURSIVE SumTo(_)
SumTo(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE occ[n] + SumTo(n - 1)
TotalTrains == SumTo(K)

\* A signal proposes moving one train from an occupied block to another.
Propose(s, f, t) ==
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ occ[f] > 0
    /\ f # t
    /\ ballot' = [from |-> f, to |-> t]
    /\ proposer' = s
    /\ votes' = {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED occ

\* Approvals arrive in arbitrary order and are tallied.
CastVote(s) ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ s \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ballot, proposer>>

\* With a quorum (including the proposer) the train is handed across.
Commit ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ proposer \in votes
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ occ[ballot.from] > 0
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![ballot.from] = @ - 1, ![ballot.to] = @ + 1]
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL

Abort ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED occ

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Signals, f \in Blocks, t \in Blocks : Propose(s, f, t)
    \/ \E s \in Signals : CastVote(s)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: quorum-approved moves only hand a train from one block to the
\* next, so the total number of trains in the interlocking never changes.
Conservation ==
    TotalTrains = Total

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    K = 3
    Signals = {s1, s2, s3}
    Quorum = 2
    Total = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A subway signalling block system moves trains between track blocks, and every
move must be approved by quorum voting among the signals. A signal proposes
moving one train from an occupied block to a different block; approvals for the
pending ballot then arrive in arbitrary order because messages can be reordered
and are tallied as they come. Once a quorum of approvals has been gathered and
includes the proposer, exactly one train is handed from the source block to the
destination block. A pending ballot may also be aborted, discarding its tally.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of trains across all blocks always equals the
starting total, because an approved move only relocates a train and never
creates or destroys one.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m4p1t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Updates, Instances, Cap, NULL

VARIABLES
    queue,     \* bounded FIFO of pending updates to the shared record
    busy,      \* busy[i]: update currently held by worker instance i, or NULL
    applied,   \* updates durably written to the shared record
    enqueued   \* every update that has ever been admitted to the queue

vars == <<queue, busy, applied, enqueued>>

QueueSet == {queue[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(queue)}
BusySet  == {busy[i] : i \in Instances} \ {NULL}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Updates)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ busy \in [Instances -> Updates \cup {NULL}]
    /\ applied \subseteq Updates
    /\ enqueued \subseteq Updates

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ busy = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ enqueued = {}

\* Producers admit an update only when the bounded queue has room (backpressure).
Enqueue(u) ==
    /\ u \notin enqueued
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, u)
    /\ enqueued' = enqueued \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, applied>>

\* Either shared instance may pull the head of the common queue.
Dequeue(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] = NULL
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = Head(queue)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, enqueued>>

\* A worker writes its held update through to the shared record.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] # NULL
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {busy[i]}
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, enqueued>>

\* Under backpressure a worker may hand its update back to the queue.
Requeue(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] # NULL
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, busy[i])
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, enqueued>>

Done ==
    /\ applied = Updates
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Enqueue(u)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Dequeue(i) \/ Commit(i) \/ Requeue(i)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: every update ever admitted to the queue is accounted for --
\* still queued, in flight at a worker, or durably applied -- so none is dropped.
NoLostUpdate ==
    enqueued = (QueueSet \cup BusySet \cup applied)

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Updates = {u1, u2, u3}
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    Cap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A vending machine network funnels updates to one shared inventory record
through a bounded work queue with backpressure. A producer admits an update
only while the queue has room below its cap. Two independent worker instances
share the single queue: either may pull the head update and hold it in flight,
then either commit it durably to the shared record or, under backpressure, hand
it back onto the queue. Once every update has been durably applied the network
is quiescent and idles. SAFETY PROPERTY: every update ever admitted to the
queue is always accounted for -- still queued, in flight at a worker, or
durably applied to the shared record -- so no admitted update is ever lost.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m5p4t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS M, Voters, Quorum, Cap, NULL

Missions == 1 .. M
Weight(m) == IF m = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1

VARIABLES
    admitted,  \* missions admitted into the airspace sector
    ballot,    \* mission currently up for an admission vote, or NULL
    votes,     \* voters whose approval has arrived (slow ones lag, none fail)
    proposer   \* voter that opened the current ballot, or NULL

vars == <<admitted, ballot, votes, proposer>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ admitted \subseteq Missions
    /\ ballot \in Missions \cup {NULL}
    /\ votes \subseteq Voters
    /\ proposer \in Voters \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ admitted = {}
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ proposer = NULL

RECURSIVE Weigh(_)
Weigh(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (IF n \in admitted THEN Weight(n) ELSE 0) + Weigh(n - 1)
SectorLoad == Weigh(M)

OpenBallot(v, m) ==
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ m \notin admitted
    /\ ballot' = m
    /\ proposer' = v
    /\ votes' = {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED admitted

\* A slow drone's approval can arrive at any later moment; it never fails.
Vote(v) ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, ballot, proposer>>

\* Admit only with a quorum AND only if it still fits the sector's capacity.
Admit ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ proposer \in votes
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ SectorLoad + Weight(ballot) <= Cap
    /\ admitted' = admitted \cup {ballot}
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL

\* If the mission would overflow the sector, the ballot is denied.
Deny ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ SectorLoad + Weight(ballot) > Cap
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED admitted

Release(m) ==
    /\ m \in admitted
    /\ admitted' = admitted \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes, proposer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Voters, m \in Missions : OpenBallot(v, m)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)
    \/ Admit \/ Deny
    \/ \E m \in Missions : Release(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the total weight of admitted missions,
\* computed directly from the admitted set, always stays within the sector cap.
BoundedCapacity ==
    SectorLoad <= Cap

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    M = 3
    Voters = {v1, v2, v3}
    Quorum = 2
    Cap = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm admits survey missions into a shared
airspace sector of bounded capacity, and each admission is decided by quorum
voting. A voter opens a ballot for a not-yet-admitted mission; approvals then
arrive as voters weigh in, and a slow drone's approval may lag arbitrarily but
never fails to arrive. A mission is admitted only when its proposer has voted,
a quorum of approvals is present, and the mission's weight still fits within
the sector capacity; otherwise the ballot is denied. Admitted missions may be
released, freeing their weight. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total weight of all
admitted missions, summed directly over the admitted set, never exceeds the
sector's bounded capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m4p5t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Feeders, Instances, Cap, NULL

VARIABLES
    queue,     \* bounded queue of shed requests (a feeder may appear twice)
    busy,      \* busy[i]: shed request held in flight by instance i, or NULL
    executed,  \* ordered log of feeders that have been shed (irreversible)
    armed      \* feeders still eligible to be shed

vars == <<queue, busy, executed, armed>>

ExecSet == {executed[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(executed)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Feeders)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ busy \in [Instances -> Feeders \cup {NULL}]
    /\ executed \in Seq(Feeders)
    /\ armed \subseteq Feeders

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ busy = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]
    /\ executed = <<>>
    /\ armed = Feeders

\* The grid may (re)request shedding an armed feeder while the queue has room.
Request(f) ==
    /\ f \in armed
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, f)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, executed, armed>>

\* Either shared instance pulls the head request.
Dequeue(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] = NULL
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = Head(queue)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<executed, armed>>

\* Shed the held feeder -- but only if it has never been shed before.
Shed(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] # NULL
    /\ busy[i] \notin ExecSet
    /\ busy[i] \in armed
    /\ executed' = Append(executed, busy[i])
    /\ armed' = armed \ {busy[i]}
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

\* A duplicate request for an already-shed feeder is simply discarded.
Discard(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] # NULL
    /\ busy[i] \in ExecSet
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, executed, armed>>

\* Backpressure: an instance may hand its request back to the queue.
Requeue(i) ==
    /\ busy[i] # NULL
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, busy[i])
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<executed, armed>>

Done ==
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ \A i \in Instances : busy[i] = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Request(f)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Dequeue(i) \/ Shed(i) \/ Discard(i) \/ Requeue(i)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no feeder ever appears twice in
\* the shed log, so no feeder is shed a second time.
ShedAtMostOnce ==
    \A a, b \in 1 .. Len(executed) : executed[a] = executed[b] => a = b

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Feeders = {f1, f2, f3}
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    Cap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT ShedAtMostOnce
nl:
A power-grid load shedder dispatches irreversible feeder-shedding commands
through a bounded work queue with backpressure. The grid may request shedding
an armed feeder whenever the queue has room, and the same feeder may be
requested more than once. Two independent worker instances share the one queue:
either pulls the head request and holds it in flight, then either sheds the held
feeder -- but only if that feeder has never been shed before, disarming it -- discards the request outright if that feeder was already shed, or under
backpressure hands the request back onto the queue. Once no feeder remains
armed and the queue and workers are clear, the shedder idles. SAFETY PROPERTY:
no feeder ever appears twice in the shed log, so the irreversible shedding of
any feeder happens at most once.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m0p0t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Stations, MaxV, NULL

VARIABLES
    version,   \* version stamp of the shared drug bin
    owner,     \* station currently dispensing from the bin, or NULL
    readv,     \* readv[s]: version station s last read, or NULL
    phase,     \* phase[s]: "idle" | "reading" | "dispensing"
    alive      \* stations that have not silently crashed

vars == <<version, owner, readv, phase, alive>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0 .. MaxV
    /\ owner \in Stations \cup {NULL}
    /\ readv \in [Stations -> (0 .. MaxV) \cup {NULL}]
    /\ phase \in [Stations -> {"idle", "reading", "dispensing"}]
    /\ alive \subseteq Stations

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ owner = NULL
    /\ readv = [s \in Stations |-> NULL]
    /\ phase = [s \in Stations |-> "idle"]
    /\ alive = Stations

\* Optimistically read the bin's current version, holding no lock.
Read(s) ==
    /\ s \in alive
    /\ phase[s] = "idle"
    /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![s] = version]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "reading"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, owner, alive>>

\* Compare-and-swap: enter only if the version is unchanged and no one dispenses.
Enter(s) ==
    /\ s \in alive
    /\ phase[s] = "reading"
    /\ readv[s] = version
    /\ owner = NULL
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ owner' = s
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "dispensing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<readv, alive>>

\* A stale read (version moved underneath) forces an optimistic retry.
Retry(s) ==
    /\ s \in alive
    /\ phase[s] = "reading"
    /\ readv[s] # version
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![s] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, owner, alive>>

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N, MaxTurn, NULL

Participants == 1 .. N
\* The token ring: at turn t the rightful holder is fixed by the ring order.
Holder(t) == (t % N) + 1

VARIABLES
    turn,        \* current ring turn; the token advances by incrementing it
    log,         \* ordered log of applied actions, each tagged [who, t]
    view,        \* view[p]: the turn participant p currently believes is live
    submitting,  \* submitting[p]: p has an action queued in the shared pool
    usedTurns    \* turns at which an action has already been applied

vars == <<turn, log, view, submitting, usedTurns>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ turn \in 0 .. MaxTurn
    /\ log \in Seq([who : Participants, t : 0 .. MaxTurn])
    /\ view \in [Participants -> 0 .. MaxTurn]
    /\ submitting \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ usedTurns \subseteq 0 .. MaxTurn

Init ==
    /\ turn = 0
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ view = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ submitting = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]
    /\ usedTurns = {}

\* The token passes to the next participant around the ring.
Pass ==
    /\ turn < MaxTurn
    /\ turn' = turn + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, view, submitting, usedTurns>>

\* A participant refreshes its cached view of the live turn.
Refresh(p) ==
    /\ view[p] # turn
    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![p] = turn]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<turn, log, submitting, usedTurns>>

\* A participant queues an action into the shared instance pool.
Submit(p) ==
    /\ ~submitting[p]
    /\ submitting' = [submitting EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<turn, log, view, usedTurns>>

Cancel(p) ==
    /\ submitting[p]
    /\ submitting' = [submitting EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<turn, log, view, usedTurns>>

\* Either shared instance applies a queued action only if the participant is
\* the rightful current holder and its view is fresh (not stale).
Act(p) ==
    /\ submitting[p]
    /\ view[p] = turn
    /\ p = Holder(turn)
    /\ turn \notin usedTurns
    /\ log' = Append(log, [who |-> p, t |-> turn])
    /\ usedTurns' = usedTurns \cup {turn}
    /\ submitting' = [submitting EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<turn, view>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Refresh(p) \/ Submit(p) \/ Cancel(p) \/ Act(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: every applied action was
\* authored by the rightful token holder for its tagged turn.
NoUnauthorizedAction ==
    \A i \in 1 .. Len(log) : log[i].who = Holder(log[i].t)

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxTurn = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT NoUnauthorizedAction
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker grants the right to act using a token ring:
at each ring turn the rightful token holder is fixed by the ring order, and the
token advances when the turn increments. Each participant caches its own view of
the live turn and may refresh it, but that view can lag and go stale. A
participant queues an action into a pool shared by two dispatcher instances, and
either instance may apply a queued action -- but only when the participant is
the rightful current token holder and its cached view is fresh, appending the
action to the log tagged with the turn. A participant may also cancel a queued
action. SAFETY PROPERTY: every applied action in the log was authored by the
rightful token holder for its tagged turn, so no stale or unauthorized
participant's action is ever applied.

    phase,     \* phase[b]: "idle" | "settling"
    ballot,    \* bank whose window request is up for a vote, or NULL
    votes,     \* banks that have approved the pending request
    override   \* bank the admin has force-granted the window to, or NULL

vars == <<holder, phase, ballot, votes, override>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Banks \cup {NULL}
    /\ phase \in [Banks -> {"idle", "settling"}]
    /\ ballot \in Banks \cup {NULL}
    /\ votes \subseteq Banks
    /\ override \in Banks \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ phase = [b \in Banks |-> "idle"]
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ override = NULL

Request(b) ==
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ phase[b] = "idle"
    /\ ballot' = b
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, phase, override>>

Approve(a) ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ a \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, phase, ballot, override>>

\* A quorum grants the exclusive window to the requesting bank.
Grant ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ holder' = ballot
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![ballot] = "settling"]
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED override

Release(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "settling"
    /\ holder = b
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ holder' = NULL
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes, override>>

\* The admin may seize the window directly, bypassing the vote.
AdminOverride(b) ==
    /\ holder = NULL
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ holder' = b
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "settling"]
    /\ override' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes>>

AdminRelease ==
    /\ override # NULL
    /\ holder = override
    /\ holder' = NULL
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![override] = "idle"]
    /\ override' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Request(b) \/ Release(b) \/ AdminOverride(b)
    \/ \E a \in Banks : Approve(a)
    \/ Grant \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion of the settlement window: any bank in the settling state is
\* exactly the single window holder, so two banks can never settle at once.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A b \in Banks : phase[b] = "settling" => holder = b

=========================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
    Quorum = 2
    NULL = NULL

A bank's interbank settlement batch grants an exclusive settlement window to at
most one bank at a time, decided by quorum voting. An idle bank may request the
window when it is free and no ballot is pending; other banks then approve the
request, and once a quorum of approvals is present the window is granted to the
requester, which begins settling. The bank that won the window by vote later releases it. A
privileged admin may instead seize the window directly for a bank, bypassing
the vote, and later release that admin-granted window. SAFETY PROPERTY: any
bank in the settling state is exactly the single current window holder, so two
banks can never settle over the shared ledger at the same time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m9p5t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Batches, Instances, MaxEpoch, NULL

VARIABLES
    epoch,      \* current configuration epoch
    prepared,   \* prepared[i]: batch instance i is preparing to finalize, or NULL
    prepEpoch,  \* prepEpoch[i]: epoch instance i read when it prepared
    settled     \* ordered log of irreversibly finalized batches

vars == <<epoch, prepared, prepEpoch, settled>>

SettledSet == {settled[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(settled)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ prepared \in [Instances -> Batches \cup {NULL}]
    /\ prepEpoch \in [Instances -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
    /\ settled \in Seq(Batches)

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ prepared = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]
    /\ prepEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ settled = <<>>

\* An epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch, staling open prepares.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, prepEpoch, settled>>

\* Either shared instance prepares to finalize an unsettled batch.
Prepare(i, b) ==
    /\ prepared[i] = NULL
    /\ b \notin SettledSet
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![i] = b]
    /\ prepEpoch' = [prepEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, settled>>

\* Finalize only with a current (non-stale) prepare and only if never settled.
Finalize(i) ==
    /\ prepared[i] # NULL
    /\ prepEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ prepared[i] \notin SettledSet
    /\ settled' = Append(settled, prepared[i])
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, prepEpoch>>

\* A prepare left stale by a reconfiguration is aborted.
Abort(i) ==
    /\ prepared[i] # NULL
    /\ prepEpoch[i] # epoch
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, prepEpoch, settled>>

\* A prepare for a batch the other instance already settled is discarded.
Discard(i) ==
    /\ prepared[i] # NULL
    /\ prepared[i] \in SettledSet
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, prepEpoch, settled>>

Done ==
    /\ SettledSet = Batches
    /\ \A i \in Instances : prepared[i] = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Batches : Prepare(i, b)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Finalize(i) \/ Abort(i) \/ Discard(i)
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no batch ever appears twice in
\* the settlement log, so no batch is finalized a second time.
FinalizeAtMostOnce ==
    \A x, y \in 1 .. Len(settled) : settled[x] = settled[y] => x = y

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Batches = {x1, x2}
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT FinalizeAtMostOnce
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch finalizes each batch irreversibly, and its
configuration is governed by epoch-numbered reconfiguration: a reconfiguration
bumps the current epoch and leaves any open preparation stale. Two independent
settlement instances share the batch pool. Either instance prepares to finalize
an unsettled batch, recording the epoch it read; it may then finalize that batch
only if its prepare is still current (its recorded epoch equals the live epoch)
and the batch has never been settled, appending the batch to the irreversible
settlement log. A prepare left stale by a reconfiguration is aborted, and a
prepare for a batch the other instance already settled is discarded. Once every
batch is settled and no preparation is open the system idles. SAFETY PROPERTY:
no batch ever appears twice in the settlement log, so the irreversible
finalization of any batch happens at most once.

    term,     \* current election term
    votes,    \* nodes that have voted for a candidate this term
    pending   \* a move [from |-> g, to |-> g'] the leader scheduled, or NULL

    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NULL}
    /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm
    /\ votes \subseteq Nodes
    /\ pending \in ([from : Segments, to : Segments] \cup {NULL})

    /\ leader = NULL
    /\ term = 0
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ pending = NULL

RECURSIVE Tally(_)
Tally(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cars[n] + Tally(n - 1)
TotalCars == Tally(K)

\* Failover: a new election term is opened, deposing any current leader.
StartElection ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, pending>>

Vote(n) ==
    /\ leader = NULL
    /\ n \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, leader, term, pending>>

BecomeLeader(n) ==
    /\ leader = NULL
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Majority
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, term, votes, pending>>

Propose(f, t) ==

    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ cars[f] > 0
    /\ f # t

\* hands a single car across -- never creating or destroying one.

    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ cars[pending.from] > 0
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![pending.from] = @ - 1, ![pending.to] = @ + 1]
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, votes>>

DropMove ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, leader, term, votes>>

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Vote(n) \/ BecomeLeader(n)
    \/ \E f \in Segments, t \in Segments : Propose(f, t)

\* equals the starting total, since every applied move only relocates a car.
Conservation ==

    ballot,    \* pending write [base |-> v] carrying the version its author read

    /\ ballot.base = version
    /\ history' = Append(history, [base |-> ballot.base])

    /\ votes' = {}

    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, history>>

    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ history' = Append(history, [base |-> version])
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes>>

    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)

\* built on version i-1 -- so no write ever overwrote a newer value it had not

empty, later leave, and release the lock once it is empty. SAFETY PROPERTY:

CONSTANTS Writers, MaxV, MaxSeats, NULL

Deltas == {1, 2}

VARIABLES
    value,    \* current value of the shared seat-count register
    version,  \* CAS version stamp of the register
    cap,      \* runtime seat capacity (changes at runtime)
    log,      \* ordered log of committed deltas
    staged    \* staged[w]: writer w's read-modify [base, readval, delta] or NULL

vars == <<value, version, cap, log, staged>>

RECURSIVE SumSeq(_)
SumSeq(s) == IF s = <<>> THEN 0 ELSE Head(s) + SumSeq(Tail(s))

    /\ value \in 0 .. MaxSeats
    /\ version \in 0 .. MaxV
    /\ cap \in 0 .. MaxSeats
    /\ log \in Seq(Deltas)
    /\ staged \in [Writers ->
           ([base : 0 .. MaxV, readval : 0 .. MaxSeats, delta : Deltas] \cup {NULL})]

Init ==
    /\ value = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ cap = MaxSeats
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ staged = [w \in Writers |-> NULL]

\* A writer reads the register (value and version) and picks a delta.
Read(w, d) ==
    /\ staged[w] = NULL
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = [base |-> version, readval |-> value, delta |-> d]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, cap, log>>

\* Compare-and-swap: commit the absolute new value only if the version is
\* unchanged (no concurrent write) and it still fits the current capacity.
CAS(w) ==
    /\ staged[w] # NULL
    /\ staged[w].base = version
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ staged[w].readval + staged[w].delta <= cap
    /\ value' = staged[w].readval + staged[w].delta
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ log' = Append(log, staged[w].delta)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

\* A stale read (version moved) fails the CAS and is discarded.
Fail(w) ==
    /\ staged[w] # NULL
    /\ staged[w].base # version
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![w] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, cap, log>>

\* Seat capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
Adjust(k) ==
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, version, log, staged>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers, d \in Deltas : Read(w, d)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : CAS(w) \/ Fail(w)
    \/ \E k \in 0 .. MaxSeats : Adjust(k)

\* No lost updates: the register's value always equals the sum of every committed
\* delta, so no committed update is ever lost by a stale write clobbering it.
NoLostUpdate ==
    value = SumSeq(log)

CONSTANTS Requests, Instances, MaxV, NULL

VARIABLES
    ver,        \* version stamp of the shared dispatch schedule
    pool,       \* shared pool of pending dispatch requests
    inflight,   \* inflight[i]: request instance i optimistically locked, or NULL
    applied,    \* requests durably applied to the schedule
    acked       \* requests acknowledged as applied to their caller

vars == <<ver, pool, inflight, applied, acked>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxV
    /\ pool \subseteq Requests
    /\ inflight \in [Instances -> ([req : Requests, base : 0 .. MaxV] \cup {NULL})]
    /\ applied \subseteq Requests
    /\ acked \subseteq Requests

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ inflight = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ acked = {}

Post(r) ==
    /\ r \notin pool
    /\ r \notin applied
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, inflight, applied, acked>>

\* Either shared instance grabs a request, reading the current version.
Grab(i, r) ==
    /\ inflight[i] = NULL
    /\ r \in pool
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![i] = [req |-> r, base |-> ver]]
    /\ pool' = pool \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, applied, acked>>

\* Optimistic commit: succeed only if the version has not moved underneath.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ inflight[i] # NULL
    /\ inflight[i].base = ver
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {inflight[i].req}
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE MaxV
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, acked>>

\* A stale optimistic lock is retried by returning the request to the pool.
Retry(i) ==
    /\ inflight[i] # NULL
    /\ inflight[i].base # ver
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {inflight[i].req}
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, applied, acked>>

\* A request is acknowledged only once durably applied.
Ack(r) ==
    /\ r \in applied
    /\ r \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, pool, inflight, applied>>

\* Only an un-acknowledged application may be rolled back to the pool.
Rollback(r) ==
    /\ r \in applied
    /\ r \notin acked
    /\ applied' = applied \ {r}
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, inflight, acked>>

Done ==
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ \A i \in Instances : inflight[i] = NULL
    /\ applied = Requests
    /\ acked = Requests
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Requests : Post(r) \/ Ack(r) \/ Rollback(r)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Requests : Grab(i, r)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i) \/ Retry(i)
    \/ Done

\* No lost updates: every request acknowledged as applied is durably present in
\* the applied schedule, so an acknowledged dispatch update is never lost.
NoLostUpdate ==
    acked \subseteq applied

    votes,      \* votes[p]: "none" | "yes" | "no"
    decision,   \* coordinator decision: "none" | "commit" | "abort"
    pdecision,  \* pdecision[p]: the decision participant p has locally adopted
    alive       \* participants that have not silently crashed

    /\ phase \in {"init", "voting", "decided"}
    /\ votes \in [Participants -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ decision \in {"none", "commit", "abort"}
    /\ pdecision \in [Participants -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]
    /\ alive \subseteq Participants

    /\ phase = "init"
    /\ votes = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ pdecision = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ alive = Participants

    /\ phase = "init"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, decision, pdecision, alive>>

    /\ p \in alive
    /\ votes[p] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = v]

    /\ decision = "none"

    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, pdecision, alive>>

    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[p] = "no"
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ phase' = "decided"

    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, pdecision, alive>>

    /\ p \in alive
    /\ pdecision[p] = "none"
    /\ pdecision' = [pdecision EXCEPT ![p] = decision]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, decision, alive>>

    /\ p \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, decision, pdecision>>

    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : p \notin alive \/ pdecision[p] # "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ StartVote \/ DecideCommit \/ DecideAbort \/ AbortOnCrash \/ Done

\* the coordinator committed, so a committed update is never lost at any

    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![r] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, shed, request>>

\* Only under the region lock may a worker take a feeder's fine lock.
LockFeeder(w, f) ==
    /\ coarse[RegionOf(f)] = w
    /\ fine[f] = NULL
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, shed, request>>

\* Shed a requested feeder while holding both locks, only if it still fits cap.
Shed(w, f) ==
    /\ fine[f] = w
    /\ coarse[RegionOf(f)] = w
    /\ f \in request
    /\ f \notin shed
    /\ ShedLoad + Weight(f) <= Cap
    /\ shed' = shed \cup {f}
    /\ request' = request \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

UnlockFeeder(w, f) ==
    /\ fine[f] = w
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, shed, request>>

UnlockRegion(w, r) ==
    /\ coarse[r] = w
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![r] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, shed, request>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Request(f)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, r \in Regions : LockRegion(w, r) \/ UnlockRegion(w, r)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, f \in Feeders : LockFeeder(w, f) \/ Shed(w, f) \/ UnlockFeeder(w, f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the total weight of shed feeders, summed
\* directly over the shed set, always stays within the shedder's capacity.
BoundedCapacity ==
    ShedLoad <= Cap

nl:
A power-grid load shedder sheds feeders under hierarchical locks: a worker must
take a region's coarse lock first, then a feeder's fine lock, before it may shed
that feeder. Shed requests arrive and are held as an unordered set, so they may
be processed in any reordered sequence. A worker holding both the region lock
and a requested feeder's fine lock sheds that feeder only if its weight still
fits within the remaining capacity; workers may release fine and coarse locks at
any time. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total weight of all shed feeders, summed directly
over the shed set, never exceeds the load shedder's bounded capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m0p2t4 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS A, Total, MaxCap, MaxV, NULL

Accounts == 1 .. A

VARIABLES
    bal,      \* bal[a]: balance held in account a
    ver,      \* ver[a]: optimistic version stamp of account a
    cap,      \* cap[a]: runtime balance capacity of account a
    pending   \* a staged transfer with the versions it read, or NULL

vars == <<bal, ver, cap, pending>>

RECURSIVE SumBal(_)
SumBal(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE bal[n] + SumBal(n - 1)

Bump(a) == IF ver[a] < MaxV THEN ver[a] + 1 ELSE MaxV

TypeOK ==
    /\ bal \in [Accounts -> 0 .. Total]
    /\ ver \in [Accounts -> 0 .. MaxV]
    /\ cap \in [Accounts -> 0 .. MaxCap]
    /\ pending \in ([from : Accounts, to : Accounts, fv : 0 .. MaxV, tv : 0 .. MaxV]
                    \cup {NULL})

Init ==
    /\ bal = [a \in Accounts |-> IF a = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ ver = [a \in Accounts |-> 0]
    /\ cap = [a \in Accounts |-> MaxCap]
    /\ pending = NULL

\* Optimistically read both accounts' versions and stage a one-unit transfer.
Begin(f, t) ==
    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ f # t
    /\ bal[f] >= 1
    /\ pending' = [from |-> f, to |-> t, fv |-> ver[f], tv |-> ver[t]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, ver, cap>>

\* Commit only if neither account's version moved and the destination has room.
Commit ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ ver[pending.from] = pending.fv
    /\ ver[pending.to] = pending.tv
    /\ bal[pending.from] >= 1
    /\ bal[pending.to] + 1 <= cap[pending.to]
    /\ bal' = [bal EXCEPT ![pending.from] = @ - 1, ![pending.to] = @ + 1]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![pending.from] = Bump(pending.from),
                          ![pending.to] = Bump(pending.to)]
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

\* A stale optimistic read fails and is retried.
Retry ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ (ver[pending.from] # pending.fv \/ ver[pending.to] # pending.tv)
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, ver, cap>>

\* Per-account capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
Adjust(a, k) ==
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![a] = k]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, ver, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Accounts, t \in Accounts : Begin(f, t)
    \/ Commit \/ Retry
    \/ \E a \in Accounts, k \in 0 .. MaxCap : Adjust(a, k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: the total balance across all accounts always equals the
\* starting total, since a transfer only moves one unit between accounts.
Conservation ==
    SumBal(A) = Total

CONSTANTS

    Total = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    MaxV = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch moves funds between accounts using
optimistic locking with retry, where each account carries a version stamp. A
settlement optimistically reads the versions of the source and destination
accounts and stages a one-unit transfer. It commits only if neither account's
version has moved since it read them and the destination still has room under
its current capacity, moving one unit and bumping both versions. If either read
is stale, the transfer fails and is retried. Each account's balance capacity is
reconfigured at runtime. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total balance across all accounts
always equals the starting total, because a transfer only moves a unit from one
account to another and never creates or destroys funds.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m4p2t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NInst, Cap, Total, NULL

Instances == 1 .. NInst

VARIABLES
    shelf,    \* number of items still on the shelf
    queue,    \* number of items in the bounded work queue
    carried,  \* carried[i]: 0 or 1 -- whether instance i is carrying an item
    bin        \* number of items delivered to the bin

vars == <<shelf, queue, carried, bin>>

RECURSIVE CarSum(_)
CarSum(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE carried[n] + CarSum(n - 1)
CarriedTotal == CarSum(NInst)

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelf \in 0 .. Total
    /\ queue \in 0 .. Cap
    /\ carried \in [Instances -> 0 .. 1]
    /\ bin \in 0 .. Total

Init ==
    /\ shelf = Total
    /\ queue = 0
    /\ carried = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ bin = 0

\* Move one item from the shelf into the bounded queue (room permitting).
Enqueue ==
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ queue < Cap
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<carried, bin>>

\* Either shared instance picks one item out of the common queue.
Pickup(i) ==
    /\ queue > 0
    /\ carried[i] = 0
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ carried' = [carried EXCEPT ![i] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, bin>>

Deposit(i) ==
    /\ carried[i] = 1
    /\ carried' = [carried EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ bin' = bin + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, queue>>

\* Under backpressure an instance returns its item to the queue.
Return(i) ==
    /\ carried[i] = 1
    /\ queue < Cap
    /\ carried' = [carried EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, bin>>

Done ==
    /\ bin = Total
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue \/ Done
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Pickup(i) \/ Deposit(i) \/ Return(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every item is always somewhere -- on the shelf, in the queue,
\* carried, or in the bin -- so the total item count never changes.
Conservation ==
    shelf + queue + CarriedTotal + bin = Total

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    NInst = 2
    Cap = 2
    Total = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet moves items from a shelf to a delivery bin through a
bounded work queue. An item is moved from the shelf into the queue whenever the
queue has room below its cap. Two independent robot instances share the one
queue: either picks a single item out of the common queue and carries it, then
either deposits the carried item into the bin or, under backpressure, returns it
to the queue. Once every item has reached the bin the fleet idles. SAFETY
PROPERTY: every item is always somewhere -- on the shelf, in the queue, being
carried, or in the bin -- so the total number of items in the system never
changes.
